# BAD-061 — web/README.md:226 still says collab thumbnails ride through the relay

## Brief
The relay was removed on purpose (web/CLAUDE.md:227); the page goes straight to Supabase and the signed storage URLs. README:226 is the same staleness BAD-046 step 8 fixes inside collabweb-model.js, but it sits outside the spike's named lines, so the split left it alone.

Evidence: web/README.md:225-226 'Join by code, from the public list (thumbnails ride through the relay; a browser only ...'. The thumb actually goes through Api.storagePut (collabweb-host.js, uploadCollabThumb) and Api.storageGet (collabweb-tab.js, loadThumb) — signed storage URLs, no Node process in between. web/CLAUDE.md:221-230 records the removal.
